summary.text: Kerry Roberts is a Republican state senator from Springfield who represents Tennessee Senate District 23 (Cheatham, Dickson, Hickman, Humphreys, Montgomery and Robertson counties) and is listed as the incumbent candidate in the 2026 election.
A certified public accountant and small business owner, he is vice-chair of the Senate Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Kerry Roberts is married and has three children, and he earned a B.S. from Lipscomb University in 1983.
His legislative biography lists him as a certified public accountant and small business owner.
Roberts has been a member of the Senate from the 109th through the 114th General Assemblies.
He is vice-chair of the Senate Judiciary Committee and a member of the Education and State and Local Government committees.

His biography lists membership in the Tennessee Society of CPAs, the National Federation of Independent Business and Tennessee Right to Life, and numerous legislator awards from advocacy and business groups.
